ridge_lasso_elasticnet.notes: Linear models are data-efficient. Current data is sufficient.

tree_models.notes: Tree models handle moderate data well. Current data is sufficient for LightGBM/HGB.

mlp.notes: MLP with ~10K params needs ~10K independent examples. Current ESS is borderline. Target dataset would be sufficient.

tcn.notes: TCN requires enough sequences for temporal convolution to learn. Current data provides ~200 effective sequences per symbol. Target dataset needed.

transformer.notes: Transformer attention needs many independent sequences for stable attention patterns. Current data is far below requirement. Advanced dataset scenario needed.
